title: C482/2177/2023 of NISCHAL RATHORE Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
SL.
No Date
Office Notes, reports,
orders or proceedings
or directions and
Registrar's order with
Signatures
COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C482 No. 2177 of 2023
Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Present Mr. Rizwan Hassan, counsel for
the petitioner.
Present Mr. G. S. Sandhu, Additional
Advocate General assisted by Ms. Mamta
Joshi, Brief Holder for the State.
2. The present C482 petition is preferred for
quashing of the F.I.R. No. 0012 of 2022 dated
19.05.2022, charge sheet dated 27.09.2022 and
the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.
6659 of 2022 pending in the court of Judicial
Magistrate 1st, Dehradun.
3. IA No. 03 of 2024 is allowed. Objection
filed on behalf of the State is taken on record.
4. A Recall Application (MCRC No. 02 of
2024) has been filed by the petitioner to recall
the order dated 26.12.2023 passed by this
Court, whereby the present petition was
dismissed on the ground that despite the
Court's order dated 10.11.2023, the steps to
serve the respondent no. 2 were not taken by
the petitioner.
5. State counsel strongly objected the
Recall Application on the ground that there is
no provision of recall in Cr.P.C..
6. Perusal of the Recall Application would
reveal that there is no good ground stated to
recall the order dated 26.12.2023. Thus, the
Recall Application is hereby dismissed
accordingly.
 (Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.)
 16.04.2024
Akash
